about: The pipeline's registry. plans: each utility's (or group's) series of published project lists; projects pair only across plans. A plan's aliases are its own other names; members are a joint plan's member utilities and parent companies, whose own lists are not the plan's. parsers: the code that reads a plan's PDFs, and the text every PDF of that layout carries (signature), which is how pipeline/ingest.py recognizes a new PDF. filings: every public filing read, oldest first; a plan's filings are ordered by edition (then date), the newest is current, earlier ones give schedule history and the change log. sha256 is the PDF a filing was read from.
